enforcement.label: Strict
enforcement.policy_text: Every handoff cup carries a handwritten note, every shift, every daypart. Store managers check compliance daily and coach any partner who misses. Compliance counts toward the store's audit score.

enforcement.label: Flexible
enforcement.policy_text: Partners are encouraged to write a note on cups whenever they can. Store managers decide what works for their store. Nothing is tracked.

enforcement.label: Adaptive
enforcement.short: Required off-peak, waived in a rush
enforcement.policy_text: Notes are expected on every cup during off-peak periods. When six or more customers are waiting, or the shift is running short-staffed, partners may skip the note. Store managers check off-peak compliance only.

note.label: Any mark
note.policy_text: Any mark counts: a smiley, a heart, a word like 'enjoy'.

note.label: Personal note
note.policy_text: The note should speak to that customer: their name, their order, something they said. A smiley alone does not count.

traffic.label: Steady
traffic.description: A steady mid-morning. The line stays short: one to four people waiting.

traffic.label: Morning rush
traffic.description: The 7 to 9 am rush. The line builds to eight to twelve people for about an hour, then falls off.

staffing.label: Full staff
staffing.description: The shift is at planned headcount.

staffing.label: Short-staffed
staffing.description: One partner called out. Everyone on the floor is covering an extra position.
